crossRefs.note: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

translations.web: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.
translations.bsb: Do not lose sight of them; keep them within your heart.
translations.kjv: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
translations.asv: Let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep them in the midst of thy heart.
